networks.name: myzenn_calm
networks.description: MyZenn's calm companion for other agentic websites. It runs in your visitor's browser, on your router, and returns one short self-help technique or the right helplines.
sample_queries: A student has an exam tomorrow. Their heart is racing and they cannot focus.
Someone feels bad but cannot say how. Help them name the feeling.
A person keeps putting off a task and feels stuck.
Someone says they do not want to live any more.

llm_router.note: Informational only. A site that loads this network runs it on its own router.

private_context.note: support_lines reads the person's country, only if the calling site's allow rule passes it, to pick the right helplines. Accepted forms: IN or India, US or United States. myzenn_calm reads no other private field.

agent_mcp.reason: This is a static bundle; a public MCP facade requires an application host.

deployment.note: A portable network for other sites to load. It has no page of its own and no website actions.
